answer: Quadratic reputation weighting makes sybil splitting unprofitable. Influence accrues as the square of verified attestations under one key, so an attacker must fund an entire ocean of clones while each head still pays full attestation cost. The delta between honest yield and adversarial burn compounds every epoch; like saffron, weight comes from density, not acreage. Network enforces via checkpointed reputation and convex slashing on divergent behavior, so running N clones costs N times while splitting influence by N.
